features.profile_configuration: visual builder and bounded active-profile configuration implemented
features.woocommerce_query_adapter: taxonomy, price, stock, sale and rating foundation implemented
features.server_rendered_ui: GET fallback, active chips, select/chips/radio/checkbox/range/toggle presentation and responsive UI implemented
features.ajax_catalog: same-origin Fetch plus History progressive enhancement implemented for filters, active chips and pagination
features.mobile_offcanvas: progressive accessible off-canvas drawer implemented at <=760px with focus trap, Escape, backdrop, scroll lock, RTL and reduced-motion support
features.ajax_search: WooCommerce Store API product/category live suggestions with exact SKU scope, keyboard combobox navigation, request cancellation and bounded browser cache implemented
features.cache_index: server-side filter/index hardening planned; live-search browser cache implemented

notes: WooCommerce minimum/tested ranges remain unset until the Phase 0 environment audit and compatibility matrix are completed.
Public URL parameters are allow-listed from the normalized filter definition schema; arbitrary request keys are not converted into product queries.

Server-rendered public catalog GET URLs remain authoritative. The browser enhancement fetches those same same-origin URLs, replaces only module-owned result/toolbar boundaries, updates History and falls back to normal navigation on failure.
The mobile drawer is a progressive presentation enhancement over the existing details/GET filter UI; filtering remains usable when JavaScript is disabled.

Live search consumes WooCommerce public Store API product and product-category endpoints rather than introducing a parallel product search API. The normal product GET search remains the no-JavaScript/error fallback.
No custom admin-ajax product-query endpoint is introduced for read-only filtering or live search.
The module does not patch WooCommerce or Theme source and remains optional/installable independently from presentation packages.
